description: Complete OTP sign-in (POST /v2/auth/verify). Requires the 6-digit code from the user's email after code-fundi-auth-authenticate. The human user must supply the token — ask them explicitly. On success, activates the API key and configures it in-memory for all subsequent tools in this MCP session. Persist CODEFUNDI_API_KEY in MCP config if the user wants auth to survive restarts.

email.description: Email address used in the authenticate step

name: code-fundi-auth-verify
